data.narrative:
Medra is a Series A-stage biotech company that has raised $52M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a universe of 3 public comparables in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers, including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable approach, given the absence of sufficient narrow peer data at identical or adjacent stages. Applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the $52M total raised proxy yields an implied valuation of $104M. Peer-median triangulation was not viable: while 7 same-sector peers exist in Biotech & Health, zero companies met the narrower filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier matching. Public-comp anchoring could not be applied; the public universe's median P/S of 8.1x cannot be operationalized without Medra's disclosed revenue, which remains unavailable.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $88M to $120M, with a median point of $104M. The range reflects reasonable upside and downside variance around the stage-progression result, which remains the sole quantifiable method. Key uncertainties include the absence of closely-matched private comparables at the same stage and the lack of disclosed revenue preventing multiples-based anchoring to public markets. This single-method support limits confidence in precision.
